Settings

Display
Martian Mono OFL · headlines and data, width axis carries rank
Text
Hanken Grotesk OFL · paragraphs only
Mono
Martian Mono OFL
Moves
mono-led, width as hierarchy, type-only hero, no giant size
Mood
precise, curious, scientific, quiet
Case
Sentence case for the narrow display; capitals only in the wide heading cut and labels, where width already separates them.
Numerals and features
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero

0.08 · 10.40 · 2026-04-030.08 · 10.40 · 2026-04-03

Slashed zero tells 0 from O in ids and readings.
Signature
Rank by width, not size: one mono family at width 75 for the display line and width 112 for the heading below it. The headline is only 56 px; the narrow-light against wide-bold contrast does the work.
Use when
Research tools, lab and sensor products, developer docs that want warmth, data journalism notes.
Turns into slop when
When mono sets whole paragraphs (reading slows), when it is chosen only to look "techy" on a product with no data, or with a terminal-green palette by reflex.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
Specimen copy is placeholder text written for this library; it describes no real product or result.
